description: The canonical dry-bed hydrodynamic dam break benchmark. Zero rain in the valley. The observations below are the recorded electrical-transformer destruction times and the police-surveyed high-water marks.

simulation_status.reason: malpasset fails validate_geometry at every coarsening tested (1, 2, 4, 8) with 'upstream/downstream seeds lack separated connected components'. It has never been simulated by this project.
simulation_status.note: This file previously carried a `simulated_s` / `simulated_min` / `simulated_wse_m` value beside every observation, and the frontend plotted them as a simulated-vs-measured agreement chart. No code in this repository produced any of those numbers. They were removed on 2026-09-13 rather than relabelled (audit Part VI §58, FS-46). Do not reintroduce a simulated series here: it must come from a run, written by the pipeline, or not at all.
simulation_status.what_would_make_it_real: A geometry manifest whose upstream and downstream seeds resolve as separated components on the Malpasset DEM, then a normal pipeline run whose measured output is compared against the observations below.

observation_provenance.wave_arrival_times: Electrical transformer destruction times, EDF post-event investigation; times relative to dam failure.
observation_provenance.high_water_marks: Police-surveyed high-water marks along the Reyran valley, 1959 post-event survey.
